ITEM 2 | Cubed pieces, roughly 1.5–2.5 cm, orange-red to brown with darker caramelized edges, matte surface with a slightly glazed or sauced sheen, firm and holding shape, covering about 15% of the plate in the lower right, about 1.5 cm tall | 110
